the question of whether the next-to-minimal extension of supersymmetric models, in particular the next-to-minimally supersymmetric standard model (NMSSM), can accommodate the observed Higgs mass, the relic abundance of cold dark matter, and the constraints from flavor physics, while at the same time being compatible with the constraints from direct and indirect searches for supersymmetric particles at the Large Hadron Collider (LHC).

the CMSSM is excluded, while the constrained next-to-MSSM is allowed, but not preferred by the data.
